name: @amykit/plugin-file-brief-store
description: Briefs kept as one file per item.
author: Nicolas Melo

amy.about: Use it when a workflow reads or writes briefs: feature-grooming waits on the brief port it mounts, prove reads the scenario a brief settled from it, and ticket-to-qa uses it when it is there. Each brief is a JSON file, kept under the project's artifact directory when there is one. It is the local default, and another adapter for the brief port can replace it.
